title: 高级 Compile 策略已收起

standard.summary: 基础 Compile 运行策略可在普通模式选择
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The basic compile runtime strategy can also be chosen in normal mode.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default, then short-test a few steps before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is on at the same time.

advanced.principle: 基础 Compile 运行策略可在普通模式选择；shape / target / cudagraph 等复杂覆盖项仍收在专家模式。关闭专家模式时不会发送 shape/target 等复杂覆盖项，后端会继续按显式启动参数优先并自动 fallback。

advanced_en.principle: The base Compile run strategy can be selected in normal mode; complex overrides such as shape / target / cudagraph stay tucked away in expert mode. When expert mode is off, those complex overrides are not sent, and the backend keeps prioritizing explicit launch arguments with automatic fallback.
